title: ApiCommand
responsibility: Exposes API resource reads, contract definitions, screenshot downloads and agent lifecycle operations through the Harness CLI.

inputs.name: ApiCommand.register.program
inputs.description: The root Commander Command that register() attaches the api command to. register() calls program.command('api') on it without validating it, so it must already be a Commander Command when register() runs.

outputs.name: ApiCommand.register
outputs.description: register() returns nothing, so callers get no value; its effect is the api command tree attached to the program. The actions that call runApi are only attached here and run later, when the CLI parses one of those subcommands, not during this call.
